pages.text: Amun's island: the spires with their shards, their beams on Amun.
Amun, the fallen xel'naga: a great winged beast circling his island, the farthest of the Void.

He flies over his foes and $(l)breaks every block in his way$(): the islands crumble where he passes. From afar he hurls void bolts (wither skulls, some of which break blocks) and dragon's breath; up close a pulse hurts and throws back all round him. 1000 health, heavy armor.

$(l)Void shards$() float on obsidian spires — six round Amun's island, four on others. While any stands, Amun cannot be hurt, and the shards near him heal him by their beams. Break them all first: by hand, with arrows, or with your army.

Every 45 seconds Amun opens a $(l)void rift$() near a foe (up to four). Out of it come troops of $(l)all three races$() — his, not their race's — every 15 seconds, stronger and stronger: zerglings and marines first, ultralisks, thors and archons at last. Break the rifts; all close when Amun dies.
$(l)When Amun dies$(), his rifts close, he leaves a dragon egg, nether stars and diamonds, and $(l)the game is complete$(): everyone in the Void sees the end and the credits, and wakes at home.
